rationale: hammernik_2017-claude-agentic: vn_T=4, vn_n_filters=24, vn_kernel=9, vn_n_bumps=31, vn_x_range=2.0, vn_filter_init_std=0.05, vn_rbf_init_std=0.01, vn_lambda_init=0.02, epochs=18, batch_size=2, lr=0.00096, grad_clip=1.0, train_n=400, val_n=200, seed=42, max_train_s=1680, rationale=iter-7 (six-box; RESCOPED after 2 OOMs). ORIGINAL plan (T=5,f=24) OOMed twice on 16GB RTX5000 in the _rho_prime RBF-bump loop (48MiB short; expandable_segments did not save it) -> FINDING: T=5 x 24-filter x 512px x 31-bump is memory-infeasible on the default node pool. Width axis must be tested at a memory-safe depth. DEPTH gradient recap (lambda=0.02): T=3 hr=0.5921, T=4 hr=0.6174, T=5 hr=0.6329 (best). ONE KNOB relative to iter-5 (T=4, f=16, hr=0.6174, ran 1660s memory-safe): vn_n_filters 16 -> 24 at T=4. HYPOTHESIS: widening the filter bank 16->24 at the memory-safe T=4 lifts hr above iter-5's 0.6174 (tests capacity/width independent of depth); if it also clears iter-6's 0.6329 the width axis beats the depth axis. All else = iter-5 (T=4, kernel=9, n_bumps=31, x_range=2.0, lambda=0.02, lr=9.6e-4, batch=2, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42, train_n=400). BUDGET: 24f/T4 ~1.5x iter-5 per-step; epochs=18 DEPENDENT budget var to hold wall <1700s under the 1800s kill; VN plateaus early so ep=18 converges. MEMORY: 24f/T4 is ~1.5x iter-5 forward memory (iter-5 was not near the 16GB limit) -> expected to fit; expandable_segments retained via --export as extra headroom. batch_size=2 (OOM guard).
